# `adi-db` — types

> The shared SQLite store for the adi platform: one WAL database per scope (global at ~/.adi/mono/db/global.db, plus one per project), opened with the same pragmas by every process — the CLI, the app, agents' tools, and Bun via the seeded @adi/db client. Pure library.

## `src/error.rs`

### type `Result`

The result type every fallible `adi-db` operation returns.

```rust
pub type Result<T> = std::result::Result<T, Error>;
```

### enum `Error`

Everything that can go wrong resolving, opening, or querying a scoped database.

```rust
#[derive(Debug)]
pub enum Error {
    Config(adi_config::Error),
    InvalidProject(String),
    NotFound(String),
    Sqlite(rusqlite::Error),
    Io(std::io::Error),
}
```

### struct `Db`

The database store: resolves, opens, and queries the per-scope SQLite files under the `db` module dir. Cheap to clone; all state is on disk.
